checkout_ref.description: The ref to use when checking out code for pipeline runs created from this trigger.

config_ref.description: The ref to use when fetching config for pipeline runs created from this trigger.

event_name.description: The name of the triggering event. Required when `provider` is `webhook` or `schedule`. Should not be set for other providers.

disabled.description: A flag indicating whether the trigger is disabled or not. Not supported for triggers where `event_source.provider` is `github_oauth`.

sender.description: The sender of the webhook. This can only be set for triggers where `provider` is `webhook`.

cron_expression.description: A cron expression defining when the trigger fires (e.g. `*/5 * * * *` for every 5 minutes).

attribution_actor.description: The actor to attribute pipeline runs to. Use `current` to attribute runs to the user who sends this update request, or `system` to attribute runs to the CircleCI system actor.

schedule.description: Schedule configuration to update for this trigger. Only applicable when `provider` is `schedule`.

parameters.description: Pipeline parameters to pass when running pipelines from this trigger. Currently only supported for triggers where `event_source.provider` is `schedule`.
The extra parameters for the rollback pipeline

org_id.description: The organization ID to create the exporter for.

endpoint.description: The OTLP endpoint to send spans to. Don't include https:// or grpc://. Just the hostname and port are required.

protocol.description: The OTLP transport to use when exporting data.

insecure.description: Whether to use an insecure connection to the endpoint.

headers.description: Additional headers to include in export requests.

tools.name: getPipelineValuesById
tools.description: Get pipeline values for a pipeline
